articles.title: Wenger decides not to challenge Fifa chief Infantino
articles.summary: Arsene Wenger decides against running for the Fifa presidency, in a boost to Gianni Infantino's hopes of a fourth term.

articles.title: Club's first match since player's death abandoned because of serious injury
articles.summary: Hendon's first match since the death of midfielder Ezekiel Williams is abandoned because of a serious injury to Ethan Creary.

articles.title: Devlin nets winner as NI top Nations League group
articles.summary: Watch highlights as Northern Ireland beat Ukraine 1-0 at Windsor Park in the Nations League.

articles.title: One for the World Cup? England's new-ball switch to Baker pays dividends
articles.summary: As England impressively levelled their three-match ODI series against Australia with a 135-run win in Adelaide, might they have stumbled upon the perfect bowling formula with one eye on the 2027 Crick

articles.title: Australia brush off New Zealand to win fourth straight Rugby League World Cup
articles.summary: Jack Bostock and Liam Martin both starred as Australia swept away New Zealand 32-12 in the men's Rugby League World Cup final to be crowned world champions for the fourth time in a row.
